kurz: The whole egg binds, lightens, emulsifies and adds colour. That is why it is in so many recipes.
bild_im_kopf: The Swiss army knife of the kitchen.
was_passiert: Egg white binds and holds air; egg yolk emulsifies and adds richness. Together they give batters and doughs structure, colour and moisture.
faustregeln: Eggs at room temperature combine better with butter.
For glazing, egg yolk with a little milk: a nice colour.

rolle.rolle: gives shine and colour as a glaze
